stage: static behavior-group prototype, not executable progress A
eligibility: five declared lab/file pairs, nonempty current actual feedback and problem, exactly one declared current Python file in original audited readable-source inventory; no target filter
eligibility_limitation: Server has prepared data only. Reuses frozen original readable-file inventory, not a new physical raw-directory check; unrecorded nested companion files are not inspected.
grouping: unchanged iff candidate text exactly equals current text; all other candidates changed, including formatting changes
q_feature_boundary: Five prespecified controls: overall frequency, lab/file frequency, current numeric logistic, past-history numeric logistic, current-feedback-size numeric logistic. Task identity is used only by task frequency; numeric logistic models do not include task one-hot features. No student ID, future text/results/time, embeddings or semantic feedback understanding claim.
q_comparison: Each prespecified control versus overall and task frequency on identical student-held-out training predictions; logloss/Brier differences and descriptive student-paired bootstrap, no model selection
q_temporal_limitation: Offline training-student split, not globally chronological online forecasting; every individual query feature is strictly current or past
primary_comparison: A+CD minus A+base: equal-student macro expected edit_location_f1 under complete candidate distributions

metric_reference_sources.actual_metrics: LLM-judged intent/location ACC, CodeBLEU, next AC AUC; not our diff F1
pass-rate/PEP8/LOC/AST Wasserstein and paired MAE; embedding cosine/Top-k; feedback MAE/RMSE and downstream AUC
test-case AUC/F1/accuracy, CodeBLEU, Dist-1; first-submission task differs

metric_reference_sources.role: log score/Brier/CRPS basis; CRPS is our proposed auxiliary edit-size metric

go_no_go: Report q versus train-held-out frequency controls and same-q conditional ranking separately; no dev metric tuning, no novelty/efficacy declaration. Null results do not reject all progress-A mechanisms.
deferred: independent test27 model run with prior static exposure disclosure
